description: A mail inbox sorted into Primary, Transactions, Updates and Promotions, with a reader and swipe actions on each row.
overview: A mail screen built on `SplitView`: the list column shows a `ToggleGroup` of four categories with unread dots, and rows with an `Avatar`, sender and preview; the detail column shows the selected message. On wide screens the list and reader sit side by side; on phones the reader opens as its own column. Swipe a row with `SwipeActions` to archive it, or swipe fully to delete. The reader has Reply, Star, Archive and Delete buttons, and Reply opens a `Textarea` to write a response.
usage: Replace `INITIAL_MAIL` with your messages and adjust `CATEGORIES` if you sort mail differently. Wire `onCategoryChange`, `onReply`, `onStarChange`, `onArchive` and `onDelete` to your mail service; the screen updates its own state either way.
